scope: Added a monotonic task deadline at the durable worker boundary; ordinary late results cannot be recorded as COMPLETED, timeout is persisted as the stable OPERATION_TIMEOUT category, and no automatic retry was added. Local cancellation/deadline does not overwrite provider health, failure counts, error, or backoff history. This receipt covers only this worker/source slice; it does not assert whole-requirement PASS.
